calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region
